title.narrative: Simposio Nacional de Mudancas Climaticas e Justica Social

description.narrative: This project will focus on the implementation of a national conference on climate change due to be held in Brasilia from 14-17 of March 2011, with the participation of civil society organisations, social movements, governmental representatives and experts on climate change issues. The conference aims to debate environmental preservation and reconstruction in the context of current levels of climate change. Themes will include: deforestation, agrotoxics, the use of soil, agrobusiness, and the use and defence of water. The main objective of the conference is to moblise civil society and churches to influence public policies and implement concrete changes on environmental issues in the context of climate change so that policies take special consideration of the poorest and most vulnerable populations. The symposium is one of the activities undertaken by the Forum on Climate Change and Social Justice which links pastoral agencies, the Bishops' Conference, social movements, and civil society. The forum aims to confront Brazil's present model of development and the destruction of natural resources, promoting alternatives to the use of soil, the preservation of forests, alternative and clean forms of energy and the better use of water resources, all of which adversely affect the poorest populations in Brazil.
